blocks.text: on, at, by, with, about — boshqa ma'nolar

Predloglar faqat joy va vaqtni bildirmaydi. Bu darsda kundalik nutqda juda ko'p uchraydigan iboralar bor: **on** holiday, **on** TV, **at** the age of 20, **by** car, a book **by** Navoi, **with** a friend, **without** sugar, a film **about** love. O'zbekchada ular turli yo'llar bilan aytiladi: `-da` (ta'til**da**, televizor**da**), «bilan», `-li` / `-siz` (soqol**li**, shakar**siz**), «haqida». Eng ko'p xato **by** bilan bo'ladi: o'zbekcha «mashina **bilan** keldim» so'zma-so'z «with car» bo'lib qoladi — to'g'risi **by car**.
on: on holiday, on TV, on fire, on time

**on** safar maqsadini bildiradi: **on holiday** (ta'tilda, dam olishda), **on business** (xizmat safarida), **on a trip / a tour / a cruise**. Axborot vositalari bilan ham **on**: **on TV**, **on the radio**, **on the phone**, **on the internet**. Yana ikki muhim ibora: **on fire** — yonyapti, **on time** — o'z vaqtida, aniq belgilangan vaqtda (kechikmasdan).

items.text: Half the class is **on holiday** this week.
There's a good comedy **on TV** tonight.

blocks.text: **at** son bilan o'lchanadigan nuqtani ko'rsatadi: yosh — **at the age of** 16 yoki qisqaroq **at** 16 (16 **yoshida**); tezlik — **at** 80 km an hour (soatiga 80 km **tezlikda**); harorat — **at** 100 degrees (100 daraja**da**). Yoshni aytishda «in the age of» yoki «with 16 years» xato — **at the age of** 16.

items.text: Kamola left home **at the age of** nineteen.
The bus was going **at** only twenty kilometres an hour.
items.translation: Avtobus soatiga atigi yigirma kilometr **tezlikda** ketayotgan edi.

blocks.text: by car, on foot; a book by ...

Transport turini aytganda **by** + **artiklsiz** ot ishlatiladi: **by** car, **by** bus, **by** train, **by** plane, **by** taxi, **by** bike, **by** boat. Piyoda esa — **on foot** («by foot» emas). Agar transportdan oldin artikl yoki egalik so'zi bo'lsa, **by** ishlatilmaydi — 107-darsdagi **in / on** keladi: **in** my car, **on** the 8.15 train. **by** ning ikkinchi ma'nosi — **muallif**: a poem **by** Navoi (Navoiy**ning** she'ri), a painting **by** Behzod, a song **by** the Beatles. Majhul nisbatda ham aynan shu **by**: The book was written **by** Navoi (21-dars).

items.text: Is it quicker to go there **by** metro or **by** bus?
This song is **by** a band from Liverpool.

blocks.text: **with** uch xil ma'noda ishlatiladi: 1) birga — I went **with** my sister (singlim **bilan**); 2) vosita — cut it **with** scissors (qaychi **bilan**); 3) nimasi bor — a man **with** a beard (soqol**li** odam), a room **with** a balcony (balkon**li** xona). **without** — buning teskarisi: coffee **without** milk (sut**siz** qahva), a day **without** rain (yomg'ir**siz** kun). O'zbekchadagi `-li` va `-siz` qo'shimchalari bu yerda juda qulay yordamchi: `-li` → **with**, `-siz` → **without**.

items.text: Kamola is the girl **with** curly hair.
I can't start my day **without** a cup of coffee.
items.translation: Bir finjon qahva**siz** kunimni boshlay olmayman.

blocks.text: **about** — «haqida»: a book **about** the Silk Road, talk **about** the weather, think **about** the future. Savol: What's the film **about**? — Film nima **haqida**? (predlog savol oxirida — 46-dars). O'zbekchada «haqida» otdan keyin, inglizchada **about** otdan oldin keladi. Diqqat: son bilan **about** — «taxminan»: **about** fifty people — taxminan ellik kishi. Fe'l + about (talk about, dream about) — 113-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I came with car.» → **I came by car.**; «by foot» → **on foot**; «by my car» → **in my car**; «in holiday» → **on holiday**; «in TV» → **on TV**; «in the age of 20» → **at the age of 20**; «a poem of Navoi» → **a poem by Navoi**; «coffee without of sugar» → **coffee without sugar**.

O'zbekcha qo'shimcha yordamchi bo'ladi: `-li` → **with** (soqolli — with a beard), `-siz` → **without** (shakarsiz — without sugar), «haqida» → **about**. Transportda «bilan» deyishga shoshilmang: transport — **by**, odam va asbob — **with**.

Bog'lanish: majhul nisbat (was written **by**) — 21-dars; on the bus / in a car — 107-dars; predlog savol oxirida (What is it about?) — 46-dars; afraid **of**, good **at** — 112-dars; talk **about**, wait **for** — 113-dars.

examples.title: **on holiday**, **on business**, **on a trip**
examples.description: Safar maqsadi — **on**: on holiday (ta'tilda, dam olishda), on business (xizmat safarida), on a trip / a tour / a cruise. «in holiday» emas.

sentences.text: My boss is **on holiday** this week.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im bu hafta **ta'tilda**.

sentences.text: Are you here **on business** or **on holiday**?
sentences.translation: Bu yerga **ish bilan** keldingizmi yoki **dam olishga**mi?

sentences.text: We went to Turkey **on holiday** last summer.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda Turkiyaga **dam olishga** bordik.

sentences.text: Aziz often goes to China **on business**.
sentences.translation: Aziz ko'pincha Xitoyga **xizmat safari bilan** boradi.

sentences.text: The students are **on a trip** to Samarkand today.
sentences.translation: Talabalar bugun Samarqandga **sayohatga** ketishgan.

sentences.text: Where did you go **on holiday** this year?
sentences.translation: Bu yil **ta'tilda** qayerga bordingiz?

sentences.text: We saw the old city **on a guided tour**.
sentences.translation: Eski shaharni gidli **ekskursiyada** ko'rdik.

sentences.text: Sarah met her best friend while she was **on holiday** in Spain.
sentences.translation: Sara Ispaniyada **dam olayotganida** eng yaqin dugonasi bilan tanishgan.

sentences.text: My parents are going **on a cruise** for their wedding anniversary.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam to'y yilligi munosabati bilan **kruizga** chiqishyapti.

sentences.text: Half of our team is away **on business**, so the office is very quiet today.
sentences.translation: Jamoamizning yarmi **xizmat safarida**, shuning uchun bugun ofis juda jim.

examples.title: **on TV**, **on the phone**, **on fire**, **on time**
examples.description: Yana **on** bilan iboralar: on TV, on the radio, on the phone, on the internet; on fire (yonyapti); on time (o'z vaqtida).

sentences.text: What's **on TV** tonight?
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun **televizorda** nima bor?

sentences.text: I heard the news **on the radio** this morning.
sentences.translation: Yangilikni bugun ertalab **radioda** eshitdim.

sentences.text: Madina is **on the phone** with her mother — she'll be back in a minute.
sentences.translation: Madina onasi bilan **telefonda** gaplashyapti — bir daqiqada qaytadi.

sentences.text: Look, that car is **on fire**! Call the fire brigade!
sentences.translation: Qarang, anavi mashina **yonyapti**! O't o'chiruvchilarni chaqiring!

sentences.text: The train left exactly **on time**.
sentences.translation: Poyezd aynan **o'z vaqtida** jo'nadi.

sentences.text: I found this recipe **on the internet**.
sentences.translation: Bu retseptni **internetda** topdim.

sentences.text: Bekzod was **on the phone** for two hours last night!
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Bekzod ikki soat **telefonda** gaplashdi!

sentences.text: Please try to be **on time** tomorrow — the bus won't wait.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ertaga **o'z vaqtida** keling — avtobus kutmaydi.

sentences.text: Did you see the football match **on TV** yesterday?
sentences.translation: Kecha **televizorda** futbol o'yinini ko'rdingizmi?

sentences.text: When the firefighters arrived, the whole roof was **on fire**.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar yetib kelganda butun tom **yonayotgan** edi.

examples.title: **at** the age of 18, **at** 90 km an hour
examples.description: Yosh, tezlik, harorat — **at**: at the age of 18 (= at 18), at 90 km an hour, at 100 degrees. O'zbekchada: 18 **yoshida**, soatiga 90 km **tezlikda**, 100 daraja**da**.

sentences.text: Mozart wrote his first piece of music **at the age of** five.
sentences.translation: Motsart ilk musiqiy asarini besh **yoshida** yozgan.

sentences.text: My grandmother got married **at** eighteen.
sentences.translation: Buvim o'n sakkiz **yoshida** turmushga chiqqan.

sentences.text: The fast train travels **at** about 250 kilometres an hour.
sentences.translation: Tezyurar poyezd soatiga taxminan 250 kilometr **tezlikda** yuradi.

sentences.text: At sea level, water boils **at** a hundred degrees.
sentences.translation: Dengiz sathida suv yuz daraja**da** qaynaydi.

sentences.text: You can get a driving licence **at** eighteen in Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda haydovchilik guvohnomasini o'n sakkiz **yoshda** olish mumkin.

sentences.text: The police stopped Tom because he was driving **at** 120 km an hour.
sentences.translation: Tom soatiga 120 km **tezlikda** haydagani uchun politsiya uni to'xtatdi.

sentences.text: **At the age of** sixty, Dilnoza's father started learning English.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning otasi oltmish **yoshida** ingliz tilini o'rgana boshladi.

sentences.text: Bake the bread **at** 200 degrees for half an hour.
sentences.translation: Nonni 200 daraja**da** yarim soat pishiring.

sentences.text: Most children in Uzbekistan start school **at** six or seven.
sentences.translation: O'zbekistonda ko'pchilik bolalar maktabga olti yoki yetti **yoshida** boradi.

sentences.text: The plane was flying **at** a height of ten thousand metres.
sentences.translation: Samolyot o'n ming metr **balandlikda** uchayotgan edi.

examples.title: **by car**, **by train**, **on foot**
examples.description: Transport turi — **by** + artiklsiz ot: by car, by bus, by train, by plane, by taxi, by bike. Piyoda — **on foot**. Artikl yoki egalik bo'lsa — **in / on**: in my car, on the 7.40 train.

sentences.text: How do you get to work? — Usually **by bus**.
sentences.translation: Ishga qanday borasiz? — Odatda **avtobusda**.

sentences.text: It's cheaper to travel **by train** than **by plane**.
sentences.translation: **Poyezdda** sayohat qilish **samolyotdan** arzonroq.

sentences.text: Madina goes to school **on foot** — it's only five minutes away.
sentences.translation: Madina maktabga **piyoda** boradi — atigi besh daqiqalik yo'l.

sentences.text: We went to Khiva **by car** and stopped in Bukhara on the way.
sentences.translation: Xivaga **mashinada** bordik va yo'lda Buxoroda to'xtadik.

sentences.text: Did you come here **by taxi**? — No, my brother drove me **in** his **car**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga **taksida** keldingizmi? — Yo'q, akam meni o'z **mashinasida** olib keldi.

sentences.text: In Oxford a lot of students get around **by bike**.
sentences.translation: Oksfordda ko'p talabalar **velosipedda** qatnaydi.

sentences.text: Can I send these documents **by email**?
sentences.translation: Bu hujjatlarni **elektron pochta orqali** yuborsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: I'd rather go **on foot** — it's a lovely day.
sentences.translation: **Piyoda** borganim ma'qul — havo ajoyib.

sentences.text: James came **on** the 7.40 **train**, so he arrived early.
sentences.translation: Jeyms soat 7:40 dagi **poyezdda** keldi, shuning uchun erta yetib keldi.

sentences.text: Travelling **by boat** along the coast is slow, but the views are amazing.
sentences.translation: Qirg'oq bo'ylab **qayiqda** sayohat qilish sekin, lekin manzaralar ajoyib.

examples.title: A poem **by** Navoi, a song **by** ...
examples.description: Muallif — **by**: a poem **by** Navoi (Navoiy**ning** she'ri, Navoiy **yozgan** she'r), a painting **by** ..., written **by** (majhul nisbat — 21-dars).

sentences.text: Have you read anything **by** Charles Dickens?
sentences.translation: Charlz Dikkens**ning** biror asarini o'qiganmisiz?

sentences.text: This is a famous poem **by** Alisher Navoi.
sentences.translation: Bu — Alisher Navoiy**ning** mashhur she'ri.

sentences.text: "Hamlet" was written **by** Shakespeare.
sentences.translation: «Hamlet»ni Shekspir **yozgan**.

sentences.text: Who is this painting **by**? — It's **by** a young artist from Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Bu rasm **kimning** asari? — Samarqandlik yosh rassom**ning**.

sentences.text: We listened to some music **by** Mozart at the concert.
sentences.translation: Konsertda Motsart**ning** musiqasini tingladik.

sentences.text: The madrasahs of the Registan were built **by** different rulers.
sentences.translation: Registon madrasalarini turli hukmdorlar **qurdirgan**.

sentences.text: Is this song **by** an English band? — Yes, they're from Liverpool.
sentences.translation: Bu qo'shiq ingliz guruhi**nikimi**? — Ha, ular Liverpuldan.

sentences.text: My favourite book is a novel **by** Abdulla Qodiriy.
sentences.translation: Eng sevimli kitobim — Abdulla Qodiriy**ning** romani.

sentences.text: The photos in this exhibition were all taken **by** children.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'rgazmadagi suratlarning hammasini bolalar **olgan**.

sentences.text: Emma is reading a book **by** an Uzbek writer, translated into English.
sentences.translation: Emma ingliz tiliga tarjima qilingan o'zbek yozuvchisi**ning** kitobini o'qiyapti.

examples.title: **with** and **without**
examples.description: **with** — «bilan» (birga yoki vosita) va «-li» (a man **with** a beard — soqol**li** odam). **without** — «-siz»: tea **without** sugar — shakar**siz** choy.

sentences.text: I live **with** my parents and my younger sister.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam va singlim **bilan** yashayman.

sentences.text: Do you drink your tea **with** sugar or **without**?
sentences.translation: Choyni shakar **bilan** ichasizmi yoki shakar**siz**?

sentences.text: Please cut the bread **with** this knife — it's sharper.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, nonni shu pichoq **bilan** kesing — u o'tkirroq.

sentences.text: Who's the old man **with** the grey beard?
sentences.translation: Oq soqol**li** anavi keksa kishi kim?

sentences.text: I can't see anything **without** my glasses.
sentences.translation: Ko'zoynag**imsiz** hech narsani ko'ra olmayman.

sentences.text: We booked a room **with** a balcony.
sentences.translation: Balkon**li** xona band qildik.

sentences.text: Don't go out **without** a coat — it's freezing.
sentences.translation: Palto**siz** tashqariga chiqmang — havo qahraton sovuq.

sentences.text: Bekzod went to the cinema **with** some friends from work.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishdagi do'stlari **bilan** kinoga bordi.

sentences.text: Madina is the girl **with** long dark hair, sitting by the window.
sentences.translation: Madina — deraza yonida o'tirgan uzun qora soch**li** qiz.

sentences.text: How did people live **without** electricity a hundred years ago?
sentences.translation: Yuz yil oldin odamlar elektr**siz** qanday yashashgan?

examples.title: **about**: a film about ..., talk about ...
examples.description: **about** — «haqida»: a book **about** history, talk **about** work, What's it **about**? O'zbekchada ko'makchi otdan keyin: tarix **haqida**.

sentences.text: What's the film **about**? — It's **about** a boy who wants to be a pilot.
sentences.translation: Film nima **haqida**? — Uchuvchi bo'lishni orzu qilgan bola **haqida**.

sentences.text: I'm reading a book **about** the history of the Silk Road.
sentences.translation: Buyuk Ipak yo'li tarixi **haqida** kitob o'qiyapman.

sentences.text: Let's not talk **about** work at dinner.
sentences.translation: Kechki ovqat paytida ish **haqida** gapirmaylik.

sentences.text: Tell me **about** your new job!
sentences.translation: Yangi ishingiz **haqida** gapirib bering!

sentences.text: There was an interesting article **about** Uzbek food in the newspaper.
sentences.translation: Gazetada o'zbek taomlari **haqida** qiziqarli maqola bor edi.

sentences.text: Sarah asked me a lot of questions **about** life in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Sara menga Toshkentdagi hayot **haqida** ko'p savol berdi.

sentences.text: Do you know anything **about** computers? My laptop isn't working.
sentences.translation: Kompyuterlar **haqida** biror narsa bilasizmi? Noutbukim ishlamayapti.

sentences.text: The teacher told us a funny story **about** her first day at school.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchi bizga maktabdagi birinchi kuni **haqida** kulgili voqea aytib berdi.

sentences.text: We watched a documentary **about** whales last night.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun kitlar **haqida** hujjatli film ko'rdik.

sentences.text: What are you two whispering **about**? — Nothing, it's a surprise!
sentences.translation: Ikkingiz nima **haqida** pichirlashyapsiz? — Hech narsa, bu syurpriz!

examples.title: Mixed: **on**, **at**, **by**, **with**, **about**
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: on business, on TV, on time, at the age of, by taxi, by (muallif), with / without, about, on foot.

sentences.text: Is Mr Karimov in the office today? — No, he's **on business** in London.
sentences.translation: Janob Karimov bugun ofisdami? — Yo'q, u Londonda **xizmat safarida**.

sentences.text: How did you get here so fast? — We came **by taxi**.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga qanday tez keldingiz? — **Taksida** keldik.

sentences.text: Who's the woman **with** the red umbrella? — That's my aunt.
sentences.translation: Qizil soyabon**li** ayol kim? — U xolam.

sentences.text: What was the programme **about**? — Life in the Arctic.
sentences.translation: Ko'rsatuv nima **haqida** edi? — Arktikadagi hayot **haqida**.

sentences.text: When did your grandfather start working? — **At the age of** fourteen, in a bakery.
sentences.translation: Bobongiz qachon ishlay boshlagan? — O'n to'rt **yoshida**, novvoyxonada.

sentences.text: Is this poem **by** Navoi? — No, it's **by** Babur.
sentences.translation: Bu she'r Navoiy**nikimi**? — Yo'q, Bobur**niki**.

sentences.text: Did you see Aziz **on TV** last night? He was talking **about** his new restaurant.
sentences.translation: Kecha Azizni **televizorda** ko'rdingizmi? U yangi restorani **haqida** gapirdi.

sentences.text: Can I pay **by card**? — Sorry, cash only.
sentences.translation: **Karta orqali** to'lasam bo'ladimi? — Kechirasiz, faqat naqd pul.

sentences.text: Why are you so late? — The bus wasn't **on time**, so I came the rest of the way **on foot**.
sentences.translation: Nega bunchalik kechikdingiz? — Avtobus **o'z vaqtida** kelmadi, shuning uchun qolgan yo'lni **piyoda** bosib o'tdim.

sentences.text: Can you make plov **without** carrots? — Not really — plov **without** carrots isn't plov!
sentences.translation: Palovni sabzi**siz** pishira olasizmi? — Yo'q-da — sabzi**siz** palov palov emas!
